---
title: "Don’t Blame Ben"
date: "2010-11-18"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Monetary Policy"]
---

[Charlie Gasparino](http://www.thedailybeast.com/blogs-and-stories/2010-11-17/ben-bernanke-the-economys-fall-guy/ "Charlie Gasparino") defends Ben Bernanke:

> *what’s happening to Bernanke now isn’t accountability, it’s a feeding frenzy. And for the good of the country, it should stop*.

Classical liberal and conservative critics of Bernanke would do well to read this [speech](http://www.dallasfed.org/research/pubs/ftc/bernanke.pdf "speech"), in which Bernanke pays tribute to Milton Friedman:

> *Friedman’s monetary framework has been so influential that, in its broad outlines at least, it has nearly become identical with modern monetary theory and practice.*
